fields.name: Performance Narrative Report (electronic artifact)
fields.description: Human-readable electronic file with searchable text, Executive Summary and Detailed Analysis; final program-manager/designee signature may be on the report or a separate signature page, with the company proprietary disclosure. Incremental data remain non-authoritative until final submission and signature. Both dollars and hours apply where applicable or as CDRL specifies. The native CPD JSON table format does not define a PNR JSON schema. Source: DI-MGMT-81861C https://quicksearch.dla.mil/WMX/Default.aspx?token=5773808. fields.name: PNR — Executive Summary: program/contract overview

acceptance.rule: Validate the actual native package against its invoked FFS and applicable DID/CDRL. Native ordinary tables are JSON arrays; DatasetConfiguration, DatasetMetadata, SourceSoftwareMetadata and ContractData are single objects. FileType.txt must equal IPMDAR_CONTRACT_PERFORMANCE_DATASET/1.0. Text entries use UTF-8; compressed entries use DEFLATE; entries are unencrypted. Empty ordinary tables may be omitted; singleton omission is permitted only if all its fields are null. A partial table alone is not a complete CPD/PNR submission.

Reject undeclared or duplicate native property names, incompatible primitive types, missing nonnullable values, nonempty values where conditions require null, forbidden string characters and invalid native string normalization. Do not add WBS/requirement association columns or contract metadata to native performance rows. Permitted null fields may be omitted or represented as JSON null; an empty string is a null representation only for String/StringID/Text, not numeric, Boolean or Date types.

Apply primary-key uniqueness separately to every table with a declared PK; singletons have no PK. Compare string key values case-insensitively while preserving supplied spelling. For SummaryIndirectPerformance_ToDate the PK is (SummaryIndirectElementID,ReportingPeriodID); for BCWS_ToDate, BCWP_ToDate, ACWP_ToDate, BCWS_ToComplete and EST_ToComplete it is (ControlAccountID,WorkPackageID,ReportingPeriodID). Do not reject a tuple merely because a component is null: actual configuration determines which components must be null. Resolve each nonnull foreign key; no foreign-key lookup is required for a permitted null. Other exact table PKs are stated with the native fields.

Reject every cost/performance row that lacks either a resolvable WBS association or a resolvable requirement association under the user-selected contract. CA/WP rows follow their native CA/WP paths and FIELD_01 custom definitions/values; summaries and other cost records without native CA/WP foreign keys require the explicit received table/key trace association. Require the FIELD_01 definition Name=requirementId where that mapping is used. No mock association substitutes for missing actual join data. The three illustrative performance rows alone cannot pass these full-feed gates. Metadata, enumeration and calendar rows are exempt from a direct cost-row join.

Reject WBS/OBS records with more than the first Level=1 root, levels below their permitted minimum, level jumps greater than one, invalid nearest-preceding-lower-level parents, a nonnull root parent or invalid hierarchy order. Reject ControlAccounts WBS/OBS joins that target nonleaf nodes. Preserve WBS and OBS array sequence when hashing.

Reject ReportingCalendar IDs that are not contiguous in record order beginning at 1, noncontiguous or overlapping period dates, and start dates after end dates. Do not silently resolve the source WorkHours/WorkingHours spelling issue; use the declared WorkingHours property, retain the disclosed interpretation of the nonnegative rule, and record any unresolved source interpretation. Preserve calendar order. Period coverage follows actual cost data and contractual performance, not arbitrary extra periods.

For each metric table, require exactly the CA/WP identifier selected by its own ByWorkPackage flag and require the other identifier to be null. ToDate_TimePhased=true requires to-date ReportingPeriodID and a value no later than DatasetMetadata.ReportingPeriodID; false requires null period IDs and cumulative-to-date semantics. To-complete period IDs are nonnull and strictly later than the reporting period. Do not substitute missing configuration with assumed defaults.

Every native detail performance record requires Value_Dollars and Value_Hours. Direct totals, element-of-cost totals, direct-by-element-of-cost values and indirect detail values must be nonnull or null exactly as their configuration branches require. The direct-by-element-of-cost branch requires both flags true; if either flag is false, those values must be null. Do not infer that all monetary or hours values must be nonnegative.

Preserve actual NonAdd_OH/COM/GA treatment; validate DEI reconciliation by reporting dimension, CA/WP rollup and time phase. Do not double-count custom summaries or non-add indirect summaries in PMB. MR permits only ReprogBA/BAC; UB permits only BAC/EAC; SummaryPerformance hours are only for PMB. Source amounts use unscaled units. A three-row illustrative table cannot prove full-package reconciliation.

Under the invoked DID/CDRL, validate CPD common metadata, reported heading/contract values, structures, reporting calendar, scope and detail performance, reprogramming and required explanatory material. Preserve applicable contract-ceiling, definitization, AUW, OTB/OTS, WP and reporting-level conditions. Do not add separately reported calculated heading values prohibited by DID §2.3.1.18. Native FFS nullable does not waive a separately applicable DID information requirement.

Require the applicable electronic human-readable searchable PNR, Executive Summary even without selected monthly variances, and Detailed Analysis for the applicable selected/requested variance set. Retain Government selection method/thresholds/categories/count limits and allowed higher reporting level; contractor fallback selection applies only absent Government direction. Require root cause, impact, mitigation, or the stated inability to mitigate with reasons as applicable. Do not make every variance row reportable.

Apply Table 2.1 Detailed Analysis content at its required frequency, ordinarily monthly unless Block 16 specifies otherwise, with event/applicability conditions preserved. Table 2.2 items are required only when tailored in through Block 16 and at the prescribed frequency. No missing tailored-out Table 2.2 item is a rejection. Report existing SRA outcomes, changes and actions without manufacturing an assessment or new engineering work.

Under the invoked DID/CDRL, require common reporting/accounting period, at least monthly reporting and the specified frequency, delivery after accounting-period close and no later than sixteen business days after period end. Final PNR or separate signature page needs the program-manager/designee signature and proprietary disclosure; incremental delivery remains non-authoritative until final submission and signature.

Reject classified material destined for EVM-CR. Carry native SecurityMarking and applicable DistributionStatement, retain disclosure and authority context, and do not equate an UNCLASSIFIED marking with public-release permission. Source requirements do not reconstruct inaccessible classification/CUI/distribution issuances.

Keep DoDI 5000.85, DoDI 5000.88, DoDM 5010.12, DoDI 5230.24, DoDI 5200.48, DoDM 5200.01 Vol 2, and the separately invoked DoDM 5200.01 Vol 4 open as affected source gaps. No extraction or substituted summary is used for them; passing accessible-source checks does not close policy/marking coverage.

Guidance, including the implementation guide and MIL-HDBK-539A, is catalogued with binding=false/kind=guidance. It does not independently reject this feed and never enters operative baseline inputs. The exclusion applies to every later batch.

When DFARS 252.234-7002(g) is incorporated and applicable access is requested, demonstrate access to pertinent EVM records and data for Government surveillance. This access check does not prescribe an invented CPD field or a universal public-release obligation.
Under the invoked CPD DEI, reject a populated OBS.SubcontractorID for a subcontractor without EVMS requirement flowdown.

Under the invoked CPD DEI, reject use of WorkPackages.EarnedValueTechniqueID for a planning package unless the value identifies level of effort or apportioned effort. Otherwise leave it unused as null or omitted.

canonicalForm: Baseline only received operative feed data plus the user-required identity/trace/marking associations, never the B catalogue. Exclude all binding=false or kind=guidance records and content justified solely by guidance. For the displayed sample hash, parse only the three native BCWS_ToDate JSON records in C.sample: no wrapper, no fictional DatasetConfiguration/metadata/calendar/WBS/custom-field associations, no PNR. The row shape is compatible with time-phased CA reporting and null direct/EOC/indirect detail, but compatibility is not proof of the actual package configuration. Preserve each supplied declared native property and null; normalize string values to NFC, trim and collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space; preserve identifier spelling. Sort these sample rows by the declared (ControlAccountID,WorkPackageID,ReportingPeriodID) tuple, comparing string IDs case-insensitively with original spelling as tie-breaker and sorting null before nonnull values. Serialize as UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, literal Unicode, JSON null/booleans, exact decimal numbers without exponent or insignificant fractional zeros and no final newline. Apply the task-wide NFC/trim/whitespace-collapse rule to the serialized text and compute lowercase SHA-256. The displayed baselineHash covers exactly this illustrative partial table and cannot attest to unprovided joins or a complete submission. For a complete accepted feed, apply the same string/number serialization and final SHA-256 normalization to one JSON object keyed by relative file identity. Prefix native ZIP entries with CPD/, PNR and signature artifacts with PNR/, and the user-required received trace associations with TRACE/; these prefixes exist only in the hash input and do not change any native file. For each native JSON entry, use the parsed JSON value, preserving supplied fields and permitted nulls. Preserve WBS.json, OBS.json and ReportingCalendar.json array order; sort every other ordinary native table by the corresponding keys.primary fields, comparing numeric keys numerically, string keys case-insensitively with original spelling as tie-breaker, and null before nonnull. Singletons remain objects. Use the normalized exact FileType.txt text. Represent each received PNR/signature artifact and each received trace-association file as standard padded base64 of its original bytes, without line breaks, so the text-based task hashing rule also covers exact non-JSON artifact content; no binary-file SHA-256 shortcut is substituted. Sort object keys lexicographically, retain every received in-scope operative native file and required association/artifact, and exclude guidance catalogues and guidance-only files/content before serialization. Reject duplicate relative file identities. The user-selected canonicalization and mandatory trace associations are contract choices, not government format mandates. No complete-feed value is computed without the actual complete inputs; the displayed baselineHash remains only the three-row illustrative native-table value.
